item.tib: yi dam phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten gtor bca' thabs
item.coloph: zhes phyi nang gsang gsum gtor ma yul phyogs su nye bar mkho ba'i rigs dang / lag len la theb pa tsam las/ rgyas pa gzhung du gsal ba rnams dang*/ bka' gsar sogs dar cha med pa rnams yig tshags su ma byas shing mdor bsdus pa 'di ni/ sprul pa'i sku bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyi thugs bzhed dang / lhag par dpe rnying bris skyon gyis bslad pa rnams bcos pa'i phyir du/ bka' lung rigs gsum tshad la gzhal te shing phag hor zla brgyad pa'i dam can 'du phyogs su mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du skyang sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgrigs pa la/ 'gal 'khrul nor ba mchis na mkhyen ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags so//
